services.name: Booking & Planning Your Cruise
services.desc: Looking for a fun, stress-free way to reward your team and bond outside the office? Ditch the boardroom for the sun-drenched shores of Percy Priest Lake. Nashville Toons offers the perfect reset with a private, captained pontoon cruise-ideal for corporate retreats, summer parties, and unforgettable team outings. Whether your crew is splashing into the lake, soaking up the sun on the top deck, or laughing over lakeside games and music, this is team building done right. No name tags, no stuffy venues - just good vibes, cold drinks, and a killer lake day. Because sometimes the best ideas - and the strongest teams - start with a change of scenery. Both boats provide a boat driver, so all you have to do is show up and have a good time. Turn up the volume and let loose. Our 14-passenger double decker pontoon is made for the ultimate party on the water. Cruise for 3 hours with your favorite people, blast your playlist over Bluetooth, slide into the lake, and soak up the vibes. This boat brings big energy for big celebrations. blurb: Guests enjoy a private boat cruise on Percy Priest Lake aboard oversized double decker or single level pontoon boats. The boats feature amenities like built-in coolers, wood bars, fresh ice, sound system, water slide, floaties, lily pad for swimming, and a stocked bathroom. Licensed boat operators staff the boats and a free shuttle service runs between downtown Nashville and the lake.
